svg.title: The cheek flower cluster in five steps, on fair skin. 1: dab a soft pink and lilac glow on the cheekbone with a sponge. 2: paint three flowers: one big pink, two small lilac. 3: yellow centers, green leaves tucked between the flowers, and two thin vines. 4: a thin black outline on the flowers. Done: white curves on the petals, light green veins and a few white dots.
